value: The comparison of menacing with prosocial scenes revealed significant group differences in a cluster in the right insula as well as in a cluster that encompassed parts of the bilateral dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) and dorsomedial prefrontal cortex (dmPFC).

These cluster differences were driven by the IPV-PTSD group having shown greater deactivation than HC when watching prosocial scenes and at the same time greater activation than HC when watching menacing scenes.
